X_1385
======

.. rubric:: MIDPOINT OF INCENTER AND CIRCUMCENTER

.. enunciation::

   :ref:`X_1385 <X_1385>` is the midpoint of incenter and circumcenter.

.. figure:: x-01385.svg
   :alt: X_1385 — MIDPOINT OF INCENTER AND CIRCUMCENTER
   :align: center

   **X_1385** (*MIDPOINT OF INCENTER AND CIRCUMCENTER*) constructed on acute reference triangle :math:`(a, b, c) = (5, 6, 7)` with unit baseline :g:`AB <[ A B ]>` = :math:`1`.

.. admonition:: Constructed Elements
   :class: note

   * **Central Lines:** :g:`{1, 3} <{ 1, 3 }>`
   * **Related Centers:** :g:`X_1 <X_1>` (:ref:`INCENTER <X_1>`), :g:`X_3 <X_3>` (:ref:`CIRCUMCENTER <X_3>`)

.. signature:: center

   | **Trilinears:** :math:`16(\operatorname{area} ABC)^{2} + a(a + b + c)(b^{2} + c^{2} - a^{2}) : :`
   | **Barycentrics:** :math:`a (2 a^{3} - a^{2} b - 2 a b^{2} + b^{3} - a^{2} c + 2 a b c - b^{2} c - 2 a c^{2} - b c^{2} + c^{3}) : :`
   | **Search Value (6, 9, 13):** :math:`4.236335701827`

Notes
-----

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`N_{a} <N_a>` = :ref:`X_5 <X_5>`-of-:g:`BC <[ B C ]>`\ :ref:`X_1 <X_1>`, :g:`N_{b} <N_b>` = :ref:`X_5 <X_5>`-of-:g:`CA <[ C A ]>`\ :ref:`X_1 <X_1>`, :g:`N_{c} <N_c>` = :ref:`X_5 <X_5>`-of-:g:`AB <[ A B ]>`\ :ref:`X_1 <X_1>`. :ref:`X_1385 <X_1385>` is the :term:`antigonal image <antigonal-image>` of :ref:`X_5 <X_5>` wrt :g:`N_{a}N_{b}N_{c} << N_a N_b N_c >>`. Also, :ref:`X_1385 <X_1385>` = :ref:`X_265 <X_265>`-of-:g:`N_{a}N_{b}N_{c} << N_a N_b N_c >>`. (:person:`Randy Hutson <randy-hutson>`, December 10, 2016)

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`A'B'C' << M_a M_b M_c >>` be the :term:`medial triangle <medial-triangle>`. :ref:`X_1385 <X_1385>` is the radical center of the incircles of :g:`AB'C' << A M_b M_c >>`, :g:`BC'A' << B M_c M_a >>`, :g:`CA'B' << C M_a M_b >>`. (Randy Hutson, December 10, 2016)
